summary: Cycle 4 fixed the cycle-3 marathon crash and hardened the runner: graceful bounded backend close (60s force < the driver's 120s backend-op bound) replacing abortive closeAllConnections() mid-SSE — the crash was the web teeing proxy's orphaned stop-turn stream (browser Stop is not propagated upstream, documented driver behavior) erroring unhandled when the backend died mid-body; plus an error-listened Readable.fromWeb bridge in the proxy, a drained restore-verify body, disk-scan android recorder stop(), per-leg diagnostics in phase-end journal events, and a mid-matrix refreshReservedDevices between engines. Uniwind passes 3/3 deterministically with full artifacts (recordings included) across three clean full marathons (c4e/c4g/c4h); nativewind android+web legs passed in c4h. Machine repairs: homebrew ffmpeg had broken x265 dyld linkage (every android recording concat died — reinstalled, verified on real segments); marathons run with TMPDIR=/tmp/ori-ai-002-scratch (reaper-proof; the worktree path overflows tsx IPC pipes). The exact six-target command still exits nonzero, blocked by a defect reproduced identically 3/3 in the write-prohibited ORI-RN-005 driver: the nativewind-ios live marker turn fails 'no terminal record' while the observed records list contains the completed record — awaitTurn takes its records baseline AFTER sendTurn returns (support/nativewind-live-example.ts:1574) and the maestro flow teardown outlasts the ~1.7s marker reply, so the record lands at index == baseline and records.length > baseline never fires; the same file's stop-turn drives already use the correct baseline-before-flow pattern (line 1677). pnpm typecheck and scoped biome are green at the checkpoint; vitest was not re-run because it awaits a fresh 1.5–2h matrix whose failure mode is exactly this diagnosed defect.
assumptions: Cycle RED was taken as the committed state's failure to have concluded the exact commands (validator exit 1 'manifest.json is missing' plus the committed cycle-3 crash logs), not a faked fast vitest red — the vitest suite spawns the full matrix, so its red IS the marathon evidence already captured.

TMPDIR=/tmp/ori-ai-002-scratch for the marathon children is an operational env choice, not a contract change: outside the agent-scratch reaper's tree and short enough for tsx IPC pipes (the worktree path fails with listen EINVAL).

A mid-matrix reboot of the RESERVED devices between engines is within this task's resource ownership (the handoff documents full reboots as the remedy; the unrelated booted simulator 9051A0C2 was never touched), so it was implemented in the orchestrator rather than treated as a blocker.
The driver-side ORI-RN-004 evidence files rewritten as a side effect of invoking the real drivers were left uncommitted — outside this task's writeAllowed paths, left dirty for the orchestrator.
blockers: support/nativewind-live-example.ts (ORI-RN-005-owned, write-prohibited to ORI-AI-002): runIosInputFlow's awaitTurn takes the records baseline after sendTurn returns, so the marker's completed record lands at index == baseline and the length>baseline terminal predicate never fires — reproduced 3/3 (c4e/c4g/c4h; diagnostics in tests/sprint-05-orient-search/evidence/ORI-AI-002/server-events.jsonl phase-end legs and .tmp/ORI-AI-002/cycle-4/red/). Fix is the baseline-before-send ordering already used by the stop-turn drives at line 1677. Until it lands, the exact matrix command cannot conclude green and the vitest suite (which awaits a fresh matrix) cannot pass.

scope_impact.found: The task's consumed interface runNativewindLiveExampleProof has a deterministic caller-composition failure on its iOS marker turn: with options.backend provided, the marker's terminal provider record (completed in ~1.7s) lands during the maestro send flow's teardown, before awaitTurn takes its records baseline, so the leg fails as 'no terminal record' while the record is present — 3/3 reproductions on freshly rebooted devices with per-leg diagnostics proving the record completed.
scope_impact.change: Charter a FIX task against support/nativewind-live-example.ts to take the records baseline BEFORE the send flow (mirroring its own stop-turn drives at line 1677) for the marker/seed/follow-up awaitTurns; then re-run ORI-AI-002's two exact verify commands — everything else in the six-target matrix is green at checkpoint d1f5d99e.
